messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team, we started seeing intermittent 400s + big tail latency spikes on the embeddings route (/v1/embeddings, model=embed-large-v2) after last night's config change (we increased max_batch_size to 64). Errors look like 'Dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024'.
Alex Park: Can you paste a minimal repro and any relevant logs? Also which customers/times?
Maya Chen: Happened across multiple tenants, spike window ~08:12-08:25 UTC. Attaching quick repro we used in staging below. It alternates between model param "embed-large-v2" and a lighter variant "embed-lite-v1" to simulate mixed clients; observed the 400s and big p99s.
Maya Chen: ```python
# repro.py
import requests, threading, time
URL = 'https://api.redwood.test/v1/embeddings'
HEADERS = {'Authorization': 'Bearer x'}
PAY1 = {'model':'embed-large-v2','input':'hello world'}
PAY2 = {'model':'embed-lite-v1','input':'hello world'}

def hit(payload):
    for i in range(50):
        r = requests.post(URL, json=payload, headers=HEADERS)
        print(r.status_code, r.text[:120])
        time.sleep(0.02)

# fire two threads simultaneously to force coalescing
t1 = threading.Thread(target=hit, args=(PAY1,))
t2 = threading.Thread(target=hit, args=(PAY2,))
t1.start(); t2.start(); t1.join(); t2.join()
```
Simon Ortega: Logs from the batcher show coalescing of mixed model variants into the same batch. There's a message: `batch_coalesce: mixed_model_variants=true max_batch_size=64` followed by `kv_cache.attach: expect_dim=1536 actual_dim=1024 -> abort`. That matches the dim mismatch error.
Alex Park: Ah — runtime is currently trying to be throughput-friendly and coalescing by timing window only, not by model embedding dimension. When a mixed set gets batched the kernel path assumes a single dim and fails.
Maya Chen: Exactly. We started seeing p99 jump from ~120ms to 2.1s during those windows and ~5% of requests returned the 400 dim error.
support-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-7291 (link) - assigned to eng-runtime.
Jessica Li: Short-term mitigation: can we temporarily reduce `max_batch_size` and/or tighten `coalesce_window_ms` for embeddings route to avoid large mixed batches? Also pin routing so embed-large-v2 and embed-lite-v1 don't share batching pools.
Simon Ortega: I can run a canary with `max_batch_size=16` and `coalesce_window_ms=2`ms on the staging embedding pool. Expect throughput drop but should eliminate mixing.
Alex Park: Long term we should make the batcher group by model signature (embedding dim + dtype) before assembling kernel batches. Also add a defensive check pre-kernel to reject mixed-dimension batches with a clearer error.
Maya Chen: For the customer-facing side, what messaging do we give for the 400s? Right now they see "Dimension mismatch" which is cryptic.
Jessica Li: Send a short note: apologizing, explain root cause is batching mixing incompatible model variants after a config change, temporary mitigation applied, ETA for fix (PATCH:group-by-signature + revert to safe batch size), and a suggested customer workaround (pin model param to one variant for now).
Alex Park: Repro notes for engineers: capture one full batch payload from the batcher and the X-Request-IDs for each req. Example log lines to grep: `batcher:assembled_ids`, `batcher:members_models`, `kv_cache:attach_err`. Also collect `batch_coalesce.window_ms` and `max_batch_size` values.
Simon Ortega: I'll run the canary now and post results in this thread. If p99 stays under 300ms and no 400s after 30m we can roll to prod with the lowered batch size.
infra-bot: canary started on staging-pool-7 with config {"max_batch_size":16,"coalesce_window_ms":2} (trace: canary-5234).
Alex Park: Action items: (1) Simon - run canary + post metrics (due: 30m), (2) Jessica - draft customer note & support runbook (due: 1h), (3) Eng-runtime - prioritize adding grouping-by-signature and pre-kernel rejection (assigning to Alex, Simon), (4) Maya - collect failing request ids and attach logs to INC-7291.
Maya Chen: Collected X-Request-IDs: rq_5b2a, rq_5b2b, rq_5b2c (will upload full payloads to the ticket).
Simon Ortega: Canary update: after 22m no dim-400s, p99 ~ 280ms. Looks promising, starting prod rollout with same settings in a staged fashion.
Alex Park: I'll open a PR for the batcher signature-grouping. Coding note: group key = (model_family, embedding_dim, dtype, quantization_profile) and disallow mixing. Add metrics `batch_group_key_mismatch_count`.
Jessica Li: Drafted customer message and support template. Putting in INC-7291 for review.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. Please ping me if you need more repro data. :thumbsup:
